name: adlc
description: Coordinates focused agents through discover → specify → plan → design → build → verify → review → release, with on-disk state, evidence, and approval gates.

approval_gates.title: Approval gates
approval_gates.description: Comma-separated gates that need your approval: plan, release. Use none to disable gates (platform permission prompts and guard prompts still apply).

guard_level.title: Guard level
guard_level.description: standard asks before commits, pushes, PRs, installs, network access, destructive commands, publishing and deploying. strict also asks before merges, rebases, worktree changes and other git history edits.

max_repair_attempts.title: Max repair attempts per task
max_repair_attempts.description: Failed attempts allowed per task before it is blocked and the coordinator stops.

max_tasks_per_run.title: Max tasks per run
max_tasks_per_run.description: Tasks dispatched per session before the coordinator stops and writes a handoff.

parallel_mode.title: Parallel build mode
parallel_mode.description: auto uses isolated git worktrees when the repository allows it, otherwise the shared checkout, and sequential when tasks are not independent. worktree and shared request a mode with the same fallbacks.

max_parallel.title: Max parallel workers
max_parallel.description: Upper bound on concurrently running build workers in parallel modes.

serial_globs.title: Serial file patterns
serial_globs.description: Comma-separated patterns for collision-prone files; tasks touching them always run alone.
